title: Stirling Approximation for the Gamma Function

problemStatement.formal: Gamma(n+1) ~ sqrt(2*pi*n) * (n/e)^n as n -> infinity, generalizing Stirling's formula from factorials to the Gamma function
problemStatement.plain: Extend Stirling's formula n! ~ sqrt(2*pi*n)*(n/e)^n to the Gamma function: Gamma(n+1) ~ sqrt(2*pi*n)*(n/e)^n at integer points, with the continuous extension Gamma(x+1) ~ sqrt(2*pi*x)*(x/e)^x stated.
whyMatters: Generalizes Wiedijk #90 (Stirling's formula) from factorials to the Gamma function
Gamma function is fundamental in analysis, probability, and physics
Log-Gamma approximation is essential for entropy calculations and statistical mechanics

proven: sqrt(2*pi*n)*(n/e)^n <= Gamma(n+1) (lower bound from stirling sequence antitonicity)
open: Continuous Stirling: Gamma(x+1)/[sqrt(2*pi*x)*(x/e)^x] -> 1 as x -> +inf (requires Laplace method)
Duplication formula at natural numbers (stated with sorry)
knownResults.goal: Full Stirling approximation for the Gamma function with bounds and error analysis

currentState.focus: Completed integer-point Stirling for Gamma, lower bounds, log-Gamma, and special values.
blockers: Continuous Stirling requires Laplace method (~500 lines of integral analysis)
Duplication formula needs careful casting between real and complex Gamma
currentState.nextAction: Submit continuous Stirling and duplication sorry to Aristotle for proof search.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Built StirlingFormulaOQ02.lean with 15+ theorems connecting Gamma to Stirling. Core results: Gamma-factorial bridge, asymptotic equivalence, lower bounds, log-Gamma bounds, Gamma(1/2)=sqrt(pi), recurrence, growth bounds, error convergence. Two sorries remain: continuous Stirling (Laplace method) and duplication formula.
insights: Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial bridges Gamma to factorials cleanly
